stem_book: Match the Column-I with Column-II. Column-I (Trigonometric Equation): (i) The solution of sin⁸x + cos⁸x = 17/32 is (ii) The general solution of the equation 2^(cos 2θ) + 1 = 3·2^(−sin²θ) (iii) The general solution of the equation sin⁵⁰x − cos⁵⁰x = 1 is (iv) The general solution of the equation (1 − sin x + … + (−1)ⁿ sinⁿx + …)/(1 + sin x + sin²x + … + sinⁿx + …) = (1 − cos 2x)/(1 + cos 2x), x ≠ (2n + 1)π/2, n ∈ Z. Column-II (General Solution): (p) x = nπ/2 ± π/8, n ∈ I (q) x = nπ or nπ ± π/2 (r) x = nπ + π/2, n ∈ Z (s) x = nπ + (−1)ⁿ π/6, n ∈ Z
